auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Enter email — we'll send a magic-link
auth.sent_body: If this email is registered, click the link in the message (expires in 30 min).

comparison.title: 🔍 Price comparison
comparison.subtitle: Cross-site matched products. Green — lowest price, red — highest.
comparison.reject_confirm:
Reject as false match?

{name}
(brand: {brand})

Pairs will be added to match_rejections, matcher won't suggest them again.
comparison.page_subtitle: Cross-site matched products. Green — lowest price, red — highest. Sorted by |spread| desc.
comparison.how_to_read: Green ▼ = pharmonline (client) is cheapest. Red ▲ = a competitor is cheaper — act. Click a column header — sort (click again toggles ▲/▼). The ▼/▲ button right of «Spread» opens a 30-day trend. The «⬇ CSV» button up top exports the filtered list.
comparison.per_unit_note: comparison normalized per unit (different pack sizes)
comparison.stale_note: Price last seen {days} days ago — excluded from spread
comparison.relink_hint: Replace the product for a site: pick from suggestions or paste your own link.
comparison.alts_none: No similar products found — paste your own link.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Today's actions and key metrics
overview.kpi_ai_hint: Share of products with reliably extracted active_ingredient/dosage/pack
overview.no_actions: No recommendations — pricing is on track.
overview.runs_desc: Click a row to see breakdown — products per site per category.
overview.breakdown_legacy: This run has no per-category breakdown — it was run before detailed stats were enabled.

analytics.title: 📈 Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Match quality, brand share, price index, forecast
analytics.no_categories: No categories with computed index yet.
analytics.no_forecast: Forecast needs ≥3 daily runs. Will appear in a few days.
analytics.forecast_desc: Products with the largest price movements. Filtered parsing artifacts (changes outside ±50%).

alerts.title: 🔔 Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Events from recent runs
alerts.empty: No alerts. Good news — pricing is on track.
alerts.page_subtitle: Events from recent runs. Inbox style: read/snoozed in separate tabs.
alerts.empty_inbox: 🎉 Inbox empty. All alerts are read or snoozed.
alerts.empty_snoozed: No snoozed alerts in current window.
alerts.empty_read: No read alerts in current window.

watchlist.title: 📋 Watchlist
watchlist.subtitle: Priority SKUs for guaranteed cross-site comparison
watchlist.empty: Watchlist is empty. Click "Add" to bind a product to URLs on 3 sites.
watchlist.empty_desc: If you have a SKU you always want on /comparison — add its URL for each site here. This bypasses the auto-matcher.
watchlist.empty_hint: Auto-matcher works for most products — watchlist is only needed for edge cases.

site.tagline_pharmonline: Main client site. Catalog, brands and ROI from pharmonline perspective.
site.tagline_aptekonline: Largest competitor by assortment. View from aptekonline perspective.
site.tagline_aloe: Boutique pharmacy. Catalog, brands and ROI from aloe perspective.
site.roi_subtitle: From {site}'s perspective — where we're cheaper/pricier vs competitors and which SKUs {competitors} has that we don't.
site.roi_loading: Analyzing pricing recommendations… may take up to 15 sec
site.roi_empty: No recommendations — pricing is on track.
site.brands_subtitle: By SKU count. Green badge — exclusive to {site} only.

categories.title: 🗂️ Categories
categories.subtitle: Categories to scrape. Each row — slug on one of the 3 sites.
categories.form_desc_add: Paste category URL from each site — slug will be extracted automatically.
categories.form_desc_edit: Edit name or slug on any site. Slug change only affects the next scrape.
categories.suggestions_new_desc: Category mapping candidates. Sorted by shared brands descending.
categories.no_overlaps: No overlaps with ≥ {n} shared brands. Lower the threshold or choose different sites.

users.title: 👥 Users & roles
users.subtitle: Who has access, which roles, and who receives the digest
users.admin_only: This section is for administrators only.
users.digest_schedule_note: The digest is sent on a schedule (server time, UTC). The toggles below decide who receives it:
users.add_hint: Users sign in via a magic-link to their email. Viewer — read-only, admin — full access.
users.cant_demote_self: You can't demote yourself to viewer

settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
settings.pricing_link_hint: Configure raise/undercut sensitivity and upload purchase prices for margin-aware actions
settings.users_link_hint: Add recipients, assign admin/viewer roles, configure the digest
settings.subtitle: Profile and account parameters
settings.name: Name
settings.email_notifs_hint: Minimum severity for email. Default — warning.
settings.telegram_bind_hint: To bind Telegram — open the bot and send:
settings.quiet_hours_hint: Format HH-HH (e.g. 22-08). Telegram won't ping during this window.
settings.password_changed: ✓ Password changed. Use the new password next time.
settings.integrations_desc: External services for notifications and monitoring.
settings.integrations_optional_hint: Each is optional — the system works without them.
settings.integration_smtp_not_ok: Not connected · can be set up in 5 min (Resend / SendGrid)
settings.integration_telegram_not_ok: Not connected · need bot token from @BotFather (free)
settings.integration_sentry_not_ok: Not connected · optional, free tier 5K events/month
settings.integration_scraperapi_not_ok: Not connected · optional for bypassing IP blocks

settings.telegram_not_configured_hint: To connect Telegram, first add TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN to /etc/pharmacy-monitor/env. Run:

banner.title: Alerts are piling up but not being delivered
banner.body: Enable email notifications or Telegram, otherwise you won't know when competitors drop prices or a site stops scraping.

pricing.title: Pricing settings
pricing.subtitle: Thresholds that the ROI engine uses to decide what to recommend or when to stay quiet.
pricing.thresholds_desc: Saving clears the ROI cache — next /overview will recompute with new values.
pricing.raise_label: Raise price when competitor is more expensive by ≥
pricing.raise_hint: Minimum gap before suggesting a raise. Lower = more «opportunity» actions.
pricing.undercut_hint: Lower = more frequent alerts. 3% is the standard sensitivity.
pricing.max_spread_label: Max spread for a valid match
pricing.max_spread_hint: Anything higher is hidden (likely bad match — unit vs pack).
pricing.min_margin_hint: If the recommended target leaves margin below this — warn «selling at loss».
pricing.max_per_type_hint: Top-N by descending spread. 10 is good for daily review.
pricing.costs_desc:
Import purchase_price for margin-aware recommendations. Columns sku, supplier_name, purchase_price required; currency, name optional.
sku must match products.external_id.

matches_review.title: Match Review Queue
matches_review.subtitle: Matches the auto-matcher wasn't confident about. Confirm or reject to improve future accuracy.
matches_review.confirm_hint: Lock this match — auto-matcher won't change it
matches_review.reject_hint: Break the cluster — products marked as different

category_comparison.title: 📊 Category comparison
category_comparison.subtitle: How much pharmonline is above or below competitors in each category. Click a row for that category's products.
category_comparison.kpi_avg_index_hint: weighted by SKU count; <100 = you're below market
category_comparison.empty: No matched products. Run a scrape and matching.
